fit: B4 = Chindemi rho + shaft-Ca licence + eCB step + timed veto (k_V 0.75) + NO; /scratch/dhuruva/perpair/w_z14b4k75_u97_fit.json
caption: B4 keeps Chindemi's ρ: c* still reads the amount of Ca, and +10 gives at least as much as −10 at every frequency (rows 1, 2 left).

Order comes from release (row 2 middle): eCB step lowers it after post→pre, the timed veto cancels the step when pre→post follows, NO adds an order-blind rise. At 40/50 Hz the step also fires on +10 (release -0.17), so +10 stays near 1 (1.11 vs data 1.53).
footnote: L5→L5, B4 model (u97, k_V 0.75), control. Row 1: pair 181455-195199, synapse 339711460, its own θd/θp. Data sources per protocol (paper + figure): figV7_sources.csv next to this figure. Papers: Sjostrom, Turrigiano & Nelson 2001 Neuron 32:1149; Markram 1997; Sjostrom 2001; Sjostrom 2003; Sjostrom 2007.
